description: This file is a JUnit test class for the NotesRepository component of an Android application, specifically testing various functionalities such as account management, note operations, synchronization status, and search features in the notes app.

classes.name: NotesRepositoryTest
classes.description: Test suite for the NotesRepository component, verifying functionality such as account management, note operations, synchronization, search, and state LiveData observables within an Android environment using Robolectric.

methods.name: setupDB
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database and test environment before each test, setting up accounts and sample notes.

methods.name: closeDb
methods.description: Closes the in-memory database after each test.

methods.name: testGetInstance
methods.description: Verifies that the singleton instance of NotesRepository is correctly instantiated and consistent.

methods.name: testGetIdMap
methods.description: Checks the correctness of the ID mapping for notes belonging to different accounts.

methods.name: testAddAccount
methods.description: Tests adding an account and its proper registration within the repository.

methods.name: testDeleteAccount
methods.description: Ensures that deleting an account removes it from the repository appropriately.

methods.name: testAddNote
methods.description: Verifies adding a new note returns correct status and content, both for local and remote notes.

methods.name: updateApiVersion
methods.description: Tests updating the API version string for an account, including validation against invalid formats.

methods.name: moveNoteToAnotherAccount
methods.description: Checks moving a note between accounts, ensuring proper deletion and addition with correct note properties.

methods.name: testSyncStatusLiveData
methods.description: Checks the live data reflecting synchronization status before and after scheduling sync.

methods.name: testSyncErrorsLiveData
methods.description: Verifies live data updates for synchronization errors after a forced sync with expected failures.

methods.name: updateDisplayName
methods.description: Tests updating an account's display name and default fallback behavior.

methods.name: searchLexicographically
methods.description: Unit test for the lexicographical search function, verifying correct ordering of notes based on titles.
